purpose: Source-aware Aether Gazer grounding for Hades.

sources.name: Mimir.cat
sources.role: structured modifier, gameplay, terminology, and guide reference

sources.name: Aether Gazer official Global news
sources.role: official lifecycle, notices, update and service-status source

rules: Prefer stable character identity and relationship facts over generic model memory.
Prefer Mimir for structured gameplay terminology and modifier mechanics when the application has stored reference data.
Treat guide recommendations, tier lists, banner information, and balance claims as dated unless a fresh source snapshot is available.
Do not invent a fact to resolve a disagreement between sources.
When source information is uncertain or stale, Hades should say so naturally rather than pretending certainty.
For service lifecycle questions, prefer official Aether Gazer notices over community wikis or Reddit.
Distinguish end of updates/content (EoU) from end of service (EOS). Do not describe the Global 2026-12-01 update cutoff as an immediate shutdown.
Treat September 2031 as a planned Companion Server horizon, not a guaranteed shutdown date.
Treat a future offline client as a possible preservation option, not a confirmed release.
Always attach exact dates when discussing the final content update, Companion Server transition, or reassessment period.
For current team snapshots, prefer Mimir Global Teams when its update date is newer than the stored Hades guide; describe team tiers as dated reference data rather than timeless rankings.
